title: Explicit physical macropore option authority for admitted reference common path

source_bound_problem.adapter_dependency: validate_legacy_request still reads global MOD_swap_base%swmacro to decide whether the admitted common route may execute
source_bound_problem.headcalc_dependency: HeadCalc still reads global swmacro on the explicit common route
source_bound_problem.matrix_fraction_dependency: FrArMtrx is used directly in storage and Jacobian terms even though the admitted F-SI14 profile requires swmacro=0, where the physical matrix fraction is unity
source_bound_problem.architectural_issue: physical-option selection is still partly hidden in legacy globals and is not separated explicitly from numerical solver policy on the common request

ownership.physical_option_selection: outside F-SI; supplied explicitly to solver

implementation_contract.common_contract: add a soil_water_physical_config_t separate from soil_water_numerical_config_t
implementation_contract.request_shape: soil_water_solve_request_t contains physical and numerical as distinct categories
implementation_contract.legacy_request_builder: copies legacy global swmacro into request%physical%macropore_active only for compatibility request construction
implementation_contract.explicit_adapter_authority: validate request%physical%macropore_active; do not read global swmacro to select the admitted common route
implementation_contract.active_macropore_request: fail closed before HeadCalc; no active macropore production path is admitted
implementation_contract.headcalc_explicit_route: consume explicit physical_config and use a local swmacro selector
implementation_contract.headcalc_legacy_route: preserve legacy global swmacro exactly when no explicit state/request binding is present
implementation_contract.inactive_matrix_fraction: exactly 1.0 on explicit macropore_active=false route; do not read FrArMtrx for admitted storage/Jacobian terms
implementation_contract.active_matrix_fraction: legacy FrArMtrx behavior remains only on legacy/direct or future separately admitted active macropore route
